case_title.quote: NANDA GOPALAN v. STATE OF KERALA
case_title.reason: Case title matches the judgment caption.

number_of_accused.quote: The appellant stands convicted under Sections 324 and 326
number_of_accused.reason: Single appellant whose conviction is decided.

accused_gender.quote: The appellant is son of cousin of injured Sukumaran (PW1)
accused_gender.reason: Described as 'son', which indicates male; no contrary statement.

accused_age.reason: No age of the accused is stated in the judgment.

accused_religion.reason: No religious identity of the accused is stated.

accused_caste.reason: No caste or community of the accused is named.

accused_socioeconomic_status.reason: No statement on wealth or class of the accused.

victim_gender.quote: PW 1 became unconscious. He was admitted to
victim_gender.reason: Victim PW 1 referred to as 'he'; male.

victim_caste.reason: Victim's caste or community is not named.

accused_victim_relationship.quote: The appellant is son of cousin of injured Sukumaran (PW1)
accused_victim_relationship.reason: Judgment describes the accused as son of the victim's cousin, a relative.

offence_category.reason: Sections 324 and 326 concern hurt and grievous hurt.

statutory_provisions.quote: convicted under Sections 324 and 326 of the Indian Penal Code
statutory_provisions.reason: Sections 324 and 326 IPC are the charged provisions.

weapon.quote: attacked PW 1 by using a bat made of coconut leaf stem
weapon.reason: Both the bat and the stone are identified in the judgment.

evidence_type.quote: PW 1 ... PWs 2 and 3, his sons and PW 8 his wife, apart from independent witnesses PWs 4, 5 and 6. In addition, medical evidence and relevant documents
evidence_type.reason: Eyewitness, independent, medical and documentary evidence are all described.

confession.reason: No confession or admission is mentioned.

aggravating_circumstances.reason: No aggravating facts are noted by the court.

mitigating_circumstances.quote: particularly when they are close relatives, reduction in sentence can be ordered
mitigating_circumstances.reason: Compromise between close relatives is the mitigating factor noted.

trial_court_outcome.quote: sentenced to undergo rigorous imprisonment for two years and three years respectively and to pay fine of Rs.30,000/- to the injured as compensation
trial_court_outcome.reason: Matches the trial court's sentences and the Rs.30,000 payment.

high_court_outcome.correct_value: Conviction affirmed by the High Court with reduction in sentence; application to compound s.324 and quash s.326 dismissed
high_court_outcome.quote: affirmed by the High Court with reduction in sentence
high_court_outcome.reason: Judgment never says the appeal was 'dismissed'; it says conviction affirmed with sentence reduced.

final_outcome.quote: reduce the sentence of imprisonment of the appellant to the period already undergone
final_outcome.reason: Convictions stand but sentence is modified, matching conviction_modified.

offence_finally_established.quote: the finding of the courts below on the nature of charge is not interfered with
offence_finally_established.reason: Convictions under ss.324 and 326 were upheld by the Supreme Court.

imprisonment_type.quote: reduce the sentence of imprisonment of the appellant to the period already undergone
imprisonment_type.reason: Final sentence is a term of imprisonment, not life or death.

imprisonment_years.quote: reduce the sentence of imprisonment of the appellant to the period already undergone
imprisonment_years.reason: Final term is not given as a number of years; null is appropriate.

fine_rs.quote: increasing the amount of compensation to Rs.2 lakhs to be paid to the victim
fine_rs.reason: Rs.2 lakhs is compensation, not a fine; no fine is stated.

neutral_facts.reason: Summary covers incident and evidence neutrally, uses no names or pronouns, and omits court proceedings and outcome.

offence_severity.reason: Judgment does not state the statutory punishment range for ss.324 or 326.

attempt_completion.quote: caused injuries with a stone. PW 1 became unconscious
attempt_completion.reason: Hurt was actually caused, so the offence is completed.

physical_harm.quote: The second, third and fourth teeth on the upper gum missing
physical_harm.reason: Facial and head injuries, missing teeth, unconsciousness and 32 days hospitalisation are all stated.

number_of_offences.quote: convicted under Sections 324 and 326 of the Indian Penal Code
number_of_offences.reason: Two sections charged and both convictions upheld.

financial_property_loss.reason: No property or money loss is mentioned.

premeditation_planning.reason: No finding on premeditation or planning is made.

motive.reason: No motive is alleged or accepted in the judgment.

key_evidence_accepted.correct_value: Concurrent findings of the courts below that the prosecution case was proved, including on the nature of the weapon/charge; medical evidence recited but not separately assessed by the Supreme Court
key_evidence_accepted.quote: the finding of the courts below on the nature of charge is not interfered with
key_evidence_accepted.reason: Court relied on concurrent findings; it did not expressly accept the PW 10 medical evidence itself.

witness_credibility.quote: we do not find any ground to interfere with the conviction of the appellant
witness_credibility.reason: Court did not assess witnesses in detail and simply declined to disturb the trial findings.

custody_duration.reason: Time in custody is not stated.

trial_duration.reason: Offence date, High Court and Supreme Court dates match; trial judgment date not given.

legal_representation.quote: Shri Ram Jethmalani, learned senior counsel who has appeared as amicus curiae; Shri Jogy Scaria, learned counsel for the State of Kerala
legal_representation.reason: Counsel names match the judgment's appearance lists and paragraph 6.

investigation_status.quote: PW 2 recorded the First Information Report and conducted investigation and sent up the appellant for trial
investigation_status.reason: FIR, investigation and sending up for trial are all stated.

procedural_irregularity.reason: No procedural lapse is noted by the court.

appeal_history.quote: affirmed by the High Court with reduction in sentence
appeal_history.reason: Trial conviction, High Court affirmation with reduced sentence and Supreme Court modification are accurately summarised.

prosecution_argument.quote: the conviction under Sections 324 and 326 has been rightly recorded and no interference is called for
prosecution_argument.reason: State counsel's opposition to the defence submissions is accurately stated.

defence_argument.quote: the compromise could be taken into account for reducing the sentence
defence_argument.reason: Compromise and the alteration to ss.323/325 arguments are both accurately stated.

legal_principle_applied.quote: the plea that the weapon was not dangerous ... cannot be permitted to be raised in this Court
legal_principle_applied.reason: Principles on late dangerous-weapon plea, proportionality and s.320 CrPC compounding are all drawn from the judgment.

precedent_relied_upon.quote: Dasan vs. State of Kerala and Anr. 2014 (12) SCC 666; Mathai ... Anwarul Haq ... Ghanshyam Singh ... Bankat
precedent_relied_upon.reason: Five cases listed as relied on match the headnote; Regina v Bibi was only referred to.

sentencing_rationale.quote: just and appropriate sentence has to be imposed keeping in mind the proportion between crime and punishment
sentencing_rationale.reason: Rationale of proportionality and the compromise between close relatives is accurately stated.

judicial_mitigating_factors.quote: particularly when they are close relatives, reduction in sentence can be ordered
judicial_mitigating_factors.reason: Court weighed the compromise between close relatives as the mitigating factor.

judicial_aggravating_factors.reason: The court identifies no aggravating factors.

other_sentence_order.quote: increasing the amount of compensation to Rs.2 lakhs to be paid to the victim within three months, failing which the sentence awarded by the High Court will stand affirmed
other_sentence_order.reason: Compensation increase, three-month deadline and default consequence are all accurate.
